title: Midnight Alchemist
description: Victorian pharmacy sim — brew potions by night, gather ingredients by day, serve six patrons at once.
detailedDescription: Live the double life of a Victorian-era alchemist. By daylight, scour the cobblestone streets, misty moors, and dimly lit apothecary gardens for rare ingredients. By night, brew complex potions in your candle-lit workshop and tend to the ailments of six simultaneous patrons. Each patron has unique needs, personalities, and escalating demands. Master a branching recipe tree, invest in equipment upgrades, and manage your reputation as word spreads through the fog-shrouded city.
controls: Click ingredients to gather during the day phase. At night, drag ingredients to the cauldron to brew. Serve patrons by delivering the correct potion.
